cases.question: Is my PC okay?
cases.text: Open investigations in the available snapshot.

cases.question: What needs attention?
cases.text: Unreviewed findings in the available snapshot.

cases.question: Explain this finding
cases.text: Recorded findings explain what triggered the observation.

cases.question: Is this finding dangerous?
cases.text: Use the finding severity and its evidence to assess concern.

cases.question: Could this finding be a false positive?
cases.text: Possible benign explanations for the recorded findings.

cases.question: What should I do?
cases.text: Suggested review steps from the recorded findings.

cases.question: Why am I seeing this alert?
cases.text: These observations are the basis for the available findings.

cases.question: List devices
cases.text: Devices reported in the available inventory.

cases.question: Who is new on my network?
cases.text: Devices flagged as new in the available inventory.

cases.question: Is this device known?
cases.text: Matching device records and their review state.

cases.question: Mark a device trusted
cases.text: Open the device record and review it there. NORTH Assistant cannot change trust.

cases.question: What connected to the internet?
cases.text: Recorded outbound connections in the available snapshot.

cases.question: Which app talked to a domain?
cases.text: Recorded events matching the requested domain or application.

cases.question: Which app talked to a country?
cases.text: Recorded application events joined to an approximate destination country by exact IP address.

cases.question: What changed since yesterday?
cases.text: Recent recorded events within the requested period.

cases.question: What can NORTH see?
cases.text: Visibility reported by the local collector and rule catalog.

cases.question: What is NORTH blind to?
cases.text: Coverage gaps reported by the local rule catalog.

cases.question: How do I fix a coverage gap?
cases.text: Review the saved remediation guidance. No settings have been changed.

cases.question: Is Sysmon installed?
cases.text: Sysmon requirements and their recorded state.

cases.question: Why is this screen empty?
cases.text: An empty view can mean collection has not started, a source cannot be read, or no matching events were recorded. Check source status and clear filters to distinguish them.

cases.question: Show events for a process
cases.text: Recorded events matching the specified process.

cases.question: Show events for a host
cases.text: Recorded events matching the specified host.

cases.question: What is this ATT&CK technique?
cases.text: Matching techniques from bundled rule metadata.

cases.question: How do I export a report?
cases.text: Open an investigation in ECHO and choose Export report.

cases.question: How do I capture traffic?
cases.text: Open ATLAS, choose Packet traces, and select an authorized adapter or open a saved capture. Begin capture from that screen.

cases.question: What leaves my PC?
cases.text: This assistant reads snapshots already available in NORTH. It sends no requests. Other NORTH features can sync observations when a cloud collector is configured.

cases.question: What can NORTH Assistant do?
cases.text: Choose a question below or include a recorded device, app, host, address, or time range.

cases.question: What is a process?
cases.text: A process is a running instance of a program. A parent process can start another process.

cases.question: What is DNS?
cases.text: DNS maps names to network records such as IP addresses. A DNS query alone does not show that a connection succeeded.

cases.question: What is a MAC address?
cases.text: A MAC address identifies a network interface on a local link. Devices can use randomized addresses.

cases.question: What is Sysmon?
cases.text: Sysmon is a Windows monitoring service that writes selected system activity to a Windows event log.

cases.question: What is ATT&CK?
cases.text: MITRE ATT&CK describes observed adversary tactics and techniques. A rule mapping indicates what a signal can help investigate.

cases.question: What is an IP address?
cases.text: An IP address identifies a network endpoint. It does not by itself establish the owner or physical location.

cases.question: List investigations
cases.text: Investigations loaded in ECHO.

cases.question: Verify my PC
cases.text: Latest Verify my PC report (2026-01-15T12:00:00Z): 1 checked and fine, 2 need a look, 3 could not be checked.

cases.question: Run the sensor self-test
cases.text: Open Detections and confirm the recorded evidence check there.

cases.question: What changed since known good?
cases.text: Recorded differences from the selected known-good snapshot.

cases.question: What is my security score and why did it drop?
cases.text: The latest posture score counts only readable checks.

cases.question: Is Defender on?
cases.text: Defender status from the latest local posture check.

cases.question: Are updates pending?
cases.text: Pending updates from the local Windows Update cache.

cases.question: How do I fix a failing check?
cases.text: Review the failed settings and use the posture panel to preview an available repair.

cases.question: Summarize my CloudTrail import
cases.text: Coverage of CloudTrail events imported on this PC.

cases.question: Explain a finding’s score
cases.text: Finding severity, evidence confidence and baseline rarity.
